open_points.subject: R0-96 pre-export room-name correction versus R0-10 room immutability
open_points.text: The import renames no room: it stores a picked project's rooms under the names the v1 instance gave them (A16), and a room is never renamed or removed afterwards (R0-10). So the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule (owner, 2026-11-23, State 0 round-59 T1).
open_points.question: May the owner rename an existing room in the VPS Registry before export as a one-time migration exception, or must the room remain immutable and the migration use some other explicitly decided way to replace the prohibited name?
options: Allow a one-time pre-export rename of existing VPS rooms, explicitly narrowing R0-10.
Keep R0-10 absolute and let the import mapping accept owner-supplied replacement room names, explicitly changing A16 and the statement that the import renames no room.
Keep both Registry and import from renaming rooms, which leaves no way to satisfy the required pre-export correction.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the pre-export correction as an explicitly documented one-time legacy-migration exception to R0-10.

witness.initial: A project selected for migration exists in the VPS Registry with a room whose stored name names a person's condition, health or needs.
events: The owner identifies that the room name breaks R0-96 before making the export.
The owner prepares the export required by R0-72.
Registry later imports the selected project under A16.
outcomes: Under the new R0-96 passage, the owner changes the existing room's name on the VPS before export, and the import copies the corrected name.
Under R0-10 and the same passage's statement that the import renames no room, the existing room cannot be renamed and the import preserves its original prohibited name.
witness.observer: The owner sees whether correction is possible, and the agent later sees either the corrected or prohibited room name.
